item.title: December 1.0 (80)
item.description: - Pressing Space on a folder now shows how big it is, right in the size column. - One shortcut measures every folder in the pane — progress at the bottom, press it again to cancel. Assign it in Settings ▸ Shortcuts. - Quick Look reports a folder's total size, subfolders included. - Settings ▸ Shortcuts: search, record a new key combination, clear it, or reset everything. - Opening a file from search now puts the cursor on that file instead of its folder. - Space opens a Markdown preview every time, not just sometimes. - Signed and notarized by Apple: no more "cannot be verified" warning, and folder access stops resetting after an update.
